note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Answers standards questions in seconds with vetted values and exact section and page citations
cases.prompt: What is the minimum clearance for a primary conductor over a public road?

cases.onepager_bullet: Interprets the full standard text when no vetted value exists, clearly labeled as unvetted
cases.prompt: Can I use a Class 5 pole on a 35-degree corner that carries a 75 kVA transformer?

cases.onepager_bullet: Routes interpretations to a standards engineer so good answers become vetted guidance
cases.prompt: Send the corner-pole interpretation to a standards engineer to confirm.

cases.onepager_bullet: Gives standards engineers one queue of interpretations to confirm and rows to re-vet
cases.prompt: What is waiting in my standards review queue?

cases.onepager_bullet: Keeps quick-reference sheets current by showing what is vetted and what needs re-vetting
cases.prompt: Show the overhead clearances quick-reference sheet and anything due for re-vetting.

cases.onepager_bullet: Scopes jobs against the standards and risk factors that apply, before design starts
cases.prompt: Scope the Maple Ridge pole replacement job: risk, effort and the standards that apply.

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
